measurements.name: half_chest
measurements.description: Quarter chest circumference plus wearing ease

measurements.name: shoulder_width
measurements.description: Horizontal distance from center front to the shoulder tip

measurements.name: neck_width
measurements.description: Half neck width: center front to where the neck curve meets the shoulder line

measurements.name: front_neck_depth
measurements.description: Vertical drop from the top of center front to the front neck curve's lowest point

measurements.name: back_neck_depth
measurements.description: Vertical drop from the top of center back to the back neck curve's lowest point (much shallower than front_neck_depth)

measurements.name: shoulder_drop
measurements.description: Vertical drop from the top of center front/back to the shoulder point

measurements.name: armhole_depth
measurements.description: Vertical distance from the top of center front/back to underarm level

measurements.name: body_length
measurements.description: Vertical distance from the top of center front/back to the hem
